statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226, was ordered
The Holter monitor was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The service was denied based on Reason Code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The billed balance for this service is 117.02
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary
